meta.title: A bid revised after the award was prepared must be re-awarded
gaps: The catalog cannot explicitly reopen bidding before the vendor revision; it only supports revising an existing vendor bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The catalog cannot explicitly reopen bidding before the vendor revision; it only supports revising an existing vendor bid.

steps.note: Open a prepared event with an existing vendor bid.
Enter the awarding flow for the existing bid.
Prepare the award allocation before the bid is revised.
Have Vendor A revise its bid through the vendor portal while the buyer session remains available.

args.because: A few bids have been revised. Please re-award to continue.

steps.note: Return to awarding and assert that the revised bid prevents continuing until the buyer re-awards.
